decision_conditions: The development must be begun not later than the expiration of five years beginning with the date of the original permission (22/08/1994).Reason: To comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990.

The premises at 4 and 6 Rosswood Gardens shall be used as a residential care home for children with learning disabilities and/or emotional and/or behavioural difficulties (EBD) and for no other purpose, including any other purpose within Class C2 of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987 (or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument amending, revoking, or re-enacting that Order).  Reason: To ensure the use remains compatible with the residential character of the area in accordance with policies 11, 28 and 29 of the Sutton Local Plan.

The premises shall be used to accommodate a maximum of two children or young people (excluding staff) at any one time per property (No. 4 and No. 6).  Reason: To ensure the intensity of the use remains consistent with a domestic, family-style setting and does not adversely impact the amenity of neighbouring occupiers in accordance with policy 29 of the Sutton Local Plan.

The use hereby permitted shall operate at all times in strict accordance with the submitted Management Plan and Good Neighbour Policy. This includes maintaining 24-hour professional supervision and ensuring local residents are provided with a designated point of contact for the Registered Manager.  Reason: To protect the residential amenity of the cul-de-sac and ensure the safe management of the site in light of the expanded care categories in accordance with policies 11 and 29 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.
